featured_reviews.name: TripperHD Vlogs
featured_reviews.review_text:
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is a state-of-the-art facility located in Charni Road, Mumbai, India. It is licensed by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for the collection, testing, processing, and storage of blood and blood components. The blood bank is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and provides services to patients at Saifee Hospital and other hospitals in the Mumbai area.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank collects 100% voluntary blood donations. All blood donors are screened for eligibility and their blood is tested for a variety of diseases, including HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, syphilis, and malaria. The blood bank also uses the latest technology to process and store blood safely and effectively.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank provides a wide range of blood and blood components, including:

Whole blood
Packed red cells
Saline-washed red cells
Fresh frozen plasma
Random platelet concentrate
Cryoprecipitate
Leucodepleted single donor platelet by plateletpheresis
Leukocytes by leukopheresis
Single donor plasma by plasmapheresis

The blood bank also provides a number of other services, such as:

Blood compatibility testing
Transfusion counseling
Blood component therapy
Blood product storage and transportation
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is committed to providing high-quality blood and blood components to patients in need. The blood bank has a team of experienced and qualified staff who are dedicated to ensuring the safety and efficacy of the blood products they supply.

featured_reviews.name: Hiren Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Feedback on My Hospitalisation Experience at Bombay Hospital

I have been admitted to Bombay Hospital on a few occasions in the past as well — not because I am fond of hospitals, but because my health conditions at times make it necessary.

During my recent admission on the 30th, of April 2026 I was initially admitted to the Critical Care ICCU on the 3rd floor. It was an extremely busy and demanding environment throughout the five nights I spent there, yet the overall dedication and efficiency of the staff stood out. Despite the pressure they work under, the doctors, nurses, and support staff carried out their responsibilities with sincerity and professionalism.

I have now been shifted to the Neuro ICCU on the 5th floor, and I would especially like to appreciate Senior Sister Jyoti and Senior Sister Surekha for the way they manage and maintain the unit. The ICCU is extremely well maintained, clean, organised, and disciplined. Their leadership reflects positively in the functioning of the entire team. The nursing staff has been warm, attentive, and committed towards patient care, and it is evident that they take pride in their duties.

Like every institution, minor flaws or occasional mistakes may happen, and there is always scope for improvement amongst some of the support staff, ward boys, ward girls, and helping staff. However, it is equally important to acknowledge the larger picture — the effort, compassion, and dedication shown daily by the nursing teams and medical staff under challenging circumstances.

Over the years, I have personally seen many nurses grow from trainees into confident and capable professionals handling immense responsibilities with maturity and experience. That growth deserves appreciation and encouragement.

I sincerely wish the entire team continued success and growth in their careers. May they keep evolving, learning, and rising further in their profession while continuing to provide compassionate care to patients and families who depend on them during difficult times.

I remain grateful and thankful for the care and support extended to me.

Hiren Mehta
Bed No. 5073
Neuro ICCU
Bombay Hospital

Hiren Mehta

featured_reviews.name: L Costa
featured_reviews.review_text:
First fail is the way they draw blood, they poke at at 45 degree angle and try to adjust the depth until blood comes out, causing pain and bleeding for days, they also leave it dangling so that the tip of the needle pokes and scratches my veins internally whenever they move and change vacuum tubes. They don’t stabilise despite telling them and just carry on.

As for the injection dyes prior to CT angio, they push it in so fast I felt my entire veins were about to explode in excruciating pain , I’ve done angios before these guys just are careless, and my entire forearm veins were painful for a whole week couldn’t even sleep properly, whenever I raised the concern they again just sway their head and say it’s ok it will subside…. Everything is met with “it’s ok don’t worry”

Their hygiene standards aren’t great I had to tell them to change cover paper sheets everytime they don’t even do that, and sometimes their rooms don’t even have cover sheets you can see how gunky and dirty it is, even that is met with “it’s ok it has been cleaned” despite it being visibly unclean. I developed boils on the back of my scalp after visiting them

As for the MRI I went in and not only was the tray not clean they didn’t even have new paper to place on the tray they had to make me wait ages to get new paper so I can lie down on it, but it doesn’t matter anyway because they give neck stabilisers that appear oily and unclean and smell of people oils , then when you go into the MRI machine you can see spit , dried up yellow / green phlegm of previous patients about 8 cm from my face and had to sit still for 30 mins of that because they can stop once started. It is clear this had not been cleaned in a while given how baked in and dried up it was inside the MRI machine.

Then you have to keep chasing for weeks for their reports and anomalies in their report , for example they list the pre fasting sugar as higher than after eating something ?? They say I have no allergy to shellfish when it can send me to hospital on anaphylaxis, they say I am highly allergic to dairy and gluten when dairy and bread is a staple diet in my daily life with zero issues ?

Their genomic report says I have low chances of high cholesterol yet I have very high cholesterol despite being in shape ?

They must be like a meat factory processing things anyhow , with no basic care on hygiene, basic techniques of blood drawing and injections, and their lab results despite complaints they double down on the most basic, like the allergy reports.

I spent 86k but honestly got pain, frustration, boils at the back of my head , and rubbish reports that my GP back home laughed at shaking his head.

These guys would have been shut down in no time if they operated overseas in any western country.

India may have great doctors but this meat factory doesn’t seem to have those given the lack or accountability and volume focus.

To potential clients: this is feedback to beware of
To NM Medical: please treat this as urgent feedback to think of seriously improving upon. It is apparent most large concerns in India have a flow of magical 5 star reviews because India has more than just talented doctors. But at the end of the day you are the land of karma and hopefully you want to go back home knowing you do a good job for the overall good of everyone and not just finances of shareholders and management 🙏
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear L Costa,

We sincerely regret the inconvenience caused. We value your feedback and will take necessary steps to improve. 

Regards, NM Medical – Marine Lines | Pathology & Radiology Lab.

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Thakkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
NM Medical at Marine Lines offers a comprehensive range of diagnostic services, including pathology, imaging, and preventive health check-ups, equipped with modern technology such as 3D Digital Mammography with Tomosynthesis, EKG, DEXA, Ultrasound, CT scans, and MRI.

You can get a wide variety of tests available under one roof. The staff is very helpful and the facility is clean. The restrooms are very well maintained and lounges are comfortable. The janitors do an excellent job. The stool and Urine sample collection is also very convenient. Once your lab work is done you can request chai (free). They also have lockers available to store your valuables.

Their vision clinic doctor is 10/10 and so do ladies handling the pathology lab. Absolutely awesome.

The reports are sent via link in text/email and most are available the same day. You will also get printed copies of the report. You can have them deliver physical medical reports to your doctor for a charge. The reports are very well organized, easy to understand and printed on good quality paper in color.

Coordinating with the facility via WhatsApp is also very convenient.

I was give anesthesia (conscious sedation) for MRI due to me being claustrophobic and was charged INR 4000 cash only which I found shady considering I paid 1.25 lakhs via credit card. I was refused bill for INR 4000. Also, the facility misplaced doctor’s letter requesting lab work which happened to include my prescriptions and letter of admission for hospital. I think they a better job managing checkin, checkout and ensuring patient documents aren’t misplaced.

One must note that there’s absolutely no cell phone network at the facility. I have Airtel, Jio and Vi SIM cards and none had network. The Wi-Fi wasn’t available during my visit. And, I think due to network limitations their credit card machines keep failing to connect with the payment processing network. It took me 1.5 hours to make the payment of 1.25 lakhs, which is absolutely insane. A lot of people were pissed during my visit but front desk showed no signs of empathy.

Overall, a good facility but some improvements in billing transparency, organization, checkin, checkout and customer service are needed.

Dear Vijay Thakkar,

We sincerely appreciate your feedback and are grateful for your support. Your kind words motivate us to serve you better.

Regards, 
NM Medical – Marine Lines | Pathology & Radiology Lab

Post this, I was guided for my sonography (abdomen and pelvic area) and mammography. The doctor was extremely gentle, patient, and explained things clearly, which instantly put me at ease.

Once the tests were done, I was escorted to a beautifully set-up breakfast area within the lab. Never before have I experienced a healthy, thoughtfully curated breakfast at a diagnostic centre. This was also when I had a conversation with the Head of the Centre, who genuinely wanted to understand how my experience had been so far.

The final test was the mammogram—something I had always been apprehensive about. However, my experience at EVA completely changed that perception. The technician was exceptionally gentle, constantly checking on my comfort and ensuring there was no distress. That long-standing fear is now truly gone.

Overall, it was a wonderful, seamless experience—completely unlike the usual diagnostic centres where waiting, confusion, and follow-ups are the norm. EVA has truly redefined what a healthcare experience can feel like.
